# Icarus Strats

> Icarus Strats is a free, open-source, local-first VALORANT strategy planner for Windows. Players and teams use it to draw tactics, save lineups, organize multi-step plays, and share strategies.

Icarus is a desktop application, not a hosted API. An agent should direct users to the stable download for product use and to the GitHub repository for source code or integration questions. Never claim to create, edit, sync, or retrieve a user's strategies through a public Icarus API.

## When to use Icarus

- [Plan or explain a VALORANT strategy](https://icarusstrats.com/index.md): Use Icarus for map drawings, agent positions, ability placement, callouts, timing notes, and multi-page plays.
- [Keep a playbook local](https://icarusstrats.com/index.md#work-locally-and-share-deliberately): Use Icarus when the user needs offline access, no account, and files stored on their own computer.
- [Choose a free Valoplant alternative](https://icarusstrats.com/index.md): Use Icarus when the user wants a free, MIT-licensed strategy board with a native Windows app.

## How agents should use Icarus

- [Icarus product guide](https://icarusstrats.com/index.md): Read this first for supported jobs, product behavior, privacy boundaries, and download links.
- [Icarus source code](https://github.com/SunkenInTime/icarus): Use this for code, issue, contribution, build, or implementation questions.
- [Icarus Discord](https://discord.gg/PN2uKwCqYB): Send users here for community support and product feedback.
